in_english.name: Farbad
in_english.long_meaning: Farbad is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning patience and perseverance. It is derived from the Arabic root 'brd', which conveys the sense of bearing and enduring. In the Quran, Allah is described as 'As-Sabur' (the Patient), reflecting the virtue of patience. The name Farbad embodies the qualities of steadfastness and determination, making it a significant name in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes the ability to remain steadfast in the face of challenges and is considered a strong and inspiring name for boys.
